name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Pripyat
description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Pripyat is a singleplayer and multiplayer open-world first-person shooter and survival horror game and the third in the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. series.

eax.problem: Stalker's X-Ray engine supports EAX via OpenAL. However the game's map data lacks environmental audio effects.
eax.fix: A community patch is available that adds environmental effects to the game's levels.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX sound effects
audio_settings.reason: The game ships with EAX (environmental audio effects) off, so room reverb and similar effects are not used. Turning it on lets OpenAL Soft apply them.
